title: QUANTIFYING THE PLAUSIBILITY OF CONTEXT RELIANCE IN NEURAL MACHINE TRANSLATION
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing a framework (PECORE) for evaluating the plausibility of context reliance in neural machine translation models. 'Plausibility' refers to the human-interpretability of model explanations and rationales, not ethical judgment, moral behavior, or religious evaluations. While bias (e.g., gender bias) is discussed, it's related to model errors, not a broader ethical or faith-based evaluation.
